source_law.control_loss: mapped_processing.cpp receive/send EOF or IO failure throws control disconnected/IO. Observed ap1_transport_error -> ap8_failure -> inspection_closed(90), after set_processing_false completion and processing-thread join where retained. No evidence of an interface query remaining in flight.
source_law.cross_process_order: Existing records lack a common per-event clock for every SDK release; exact Windows/native/frontend ordering is not asserted beyond local sequence and retained anchors.
source_law.editor_order: inspect_module.cpp bind_controller(nullptr,false) before disconnect/clear handler/component terminate; ap11_editor_summary opens/closes and Windows sequence provide bounded observable confirmation, not invented release callbacks.
source_law.missing_native_summaries: Present in some complete exits, absent in others; not sufficient to diagnose the earlier UI hang.
